findings.claim: The driver satisfied the NS-1 proximity condition: closest approach to the pickup was 24 m, within the 150 m limit.
The driver satisfied the NS-1 contact-attempt condition: one recorded driver message before cancelling, meeting the minimum of one.
The driver did NOT satisfy the NS-1 minimum-wait condition: only 210 seconds elapsed between first coming within 150 m (10:22:44Z) and cancellation (10:26:14Z), below the required 300 seconds.
The rider was actively en route, messaging at 10:25:14Z that they were 'Coming down now, 2 minutes!', and the driver cancelled about one minute later.
Because at least one NS-1 condition is unmet, NS-2 mandates refunding the exact paid no-show fee of S$5.00.
Party history is context only and cannot establish fault or override trip evidence.

result.reasoning: The no-show fee is retainable only when all three NS-1 conditions are met. GPS-PICKUP shows the proximity condition MET (24 m, within 150 m) and CHAT-SUMMARY shows the contact-attempt condition MET (1 driver message, minimum 1). However, GPS-PICKUP shows the wait condition NOT MET: only 210 seconds elapsed from first coming within 150 m (10:22:44Z) to cancellation (10:26:14Z), short of the required 300 seconds. Because one NS-1 condition is unmet, NS-2 requires refunding the exact paid no-show fee. PAY-FARE confirms S$5.00 paid and PAY-REMEDY computes the eligible refund as S$5.00. The rider's message at 10:25:14Z further corroborates that the rider was actively en route when the driver cancelled about a minute later. History is context only under NS-4 and does not change the outcome.

Your message at 10:25:14Z also shows you were on your way down. Because a required condition for keeping the no-show fee was not met, you will receive a full refund of the S$5.00 no-show fee.

However, the GPS record shows you cancelled only 210 seconds after first coming within 150 m of the pickup, which is below the 300-second minimum wait required by policy. Because not all three conditions were met, the no-show fee cannot be retained and the S$5.00 fee will be refunded to the rider.
